caption:
There is a specific kind of focus required when mountain biking in Costa Rica, climbing through the damp air of our high mountain passes. These remote doubletracks are never truly flat; they demand constant adjustments to traction, a steady cadence, and a deep respect for the damp clay beneath your tires. I spend hundreds of hours scouting these backroads to ensure every route we share rewards you with the true character of our terrain. Worth sharing with someone who appreciates the climb.
